lab_declaration: 本任务属于 aetfq3-lab / Lab，不属于 V2.1 Stable。
phase: F public intraday group-level past-only feature expansion design

feature_categories.purpose: Summarize anchor-day price path and bar-level return shape.
Summarize anchor-day activity, concentration, and late-session intensity.
Summarize direction, reversal, and VWAP positioning inside the anchor day.
Add daily context using only anchor day or prior daily data.
Compare each ETF with the same-anchor-date visible ETF universe.

feature_contract.name: open_first
feature_contract.formula: first open value among anchor-day 5m bars ordered by datetime
feature_contract.known_risk: requires deterministic bar ordering and non-null first open

feature_contract.name: high_max
feature_contract.formula: max(high) over anchor-day 5m bars
feature_contract.known_risk: only valid for end-of-anchor-day diagnostics, not intraday live decisions

feature_contract.name: low_min
feature_contract.formula: min(low) over anchor-day 5m bars
feature_contract.known_risk: only valid for end-of-anchor-day diagnostics, not intraday live decisions

feature_contract.name: close_last
feature_contract.formula: last close value among anchor-day 5m bars ordered by datetime
feature_contract.known_risk: requires explicit end-of-day diagnostic boundary

feature_contract.name: vwap_day
feature_contract.formula: sum(amount) / sum(volume) over anchor-day 5m bars
feature_contract.known_risk: must handle zero or missing volume denominator

feature_contract.name: day_return
feature_contract.formula: close_last / open_first - 1
feature_contract.known_risk: only valid after anchor-day close

feature_contract.name: high_low_range
feature_contract.formula: high_max / low_min - 1
feature_contract.known_risk: must handle zero or missing low denominator

feature_contract.name: close_to_vwap
feature_contract.formula: close_last / vwap_day - 1
feature_contract.known_risk: must handle missing or zero vwap_day

feature_contract.name: intraday_return_mean
feature_contract.formula: mean(close_t / close_t_minus_1 - 1) over anchor-day ordered bars
feature_contract.known_risk: requires consistent return definition for first bar

feature_contract.name: intraday_return_std
feature_contract.formula: population std(close_t / close_t_minus_1 - 1) over anchor-day ordered bars
feature_contract.known_risk: small or constant bars can produce zero variance

feature_contract.name: intraday_return_skew
feature_contract.formula: skew(close_t / close_t_minus_1 - 1) over anchor-day ordered bars
feature_contract.known_risk: undefined when variance is zero; implementation must impute or flag

feature_contract.name: intraday_return_min
feature_contract.formula: min(close_t / close_t_minus_1 - 1) over anchor-day ordered bars
feature_contract.known_risk: sensitive to isolated bad ticks or bad bars

feature_contract.name: intraday_return_max
feature_contract.formula: max(close_t / close_t_minus_1 - 1) over anchor-day ordered bars
feature_contract.known_risk: sensitive to isolated bad ticks or bad bars

feature_contract.name: volume_sum
feature_contract.formula: sum(volume) over anchor-day 5m bars
feature_contract.known_risk: large scale feature; later diagnostics should use train-only scaling if scaling is required

feature_contract.name: amount_sum
feature_contract.formula: sum(amount) over anchor-day 5m bars
feature_contract.known_risk: large scale feature; later diagnostics should use train-only scaling if scaling is required

feature_contract.name: volume_first_half_sum
feature_contract.formula: sum(volume) over the first half of anchor-day ordered bars
feature_contract.known_risk: requires stable bar count or explicit session split

feature_contract.name: volume_second_half_sum
feature_contract.formula: sum(volume) over the second half of anchor-day ordered bars
feature_contract.known_risk: only valid after second half completes

feature_contract.name: amount_first_half_sum
feature_contract.formula: sum(amount) over the first half of anchor-day ordered bars
feature_contract.known_risk: requires stable bar count or explicit session split

feature_contract.name: amount_second_half_sum
feature_contract.formula: sum(amount) over the second half of anchor-day ordered bars
feature_contract.known_risk: only valid after second half completes

feature_contract.name: volume_second_half_ratio
feature_contract.formula: volume_second_half_sum / volume_sum
feature_contract.known_risk: must handle zero or missing volume_sum

feature_contract.name: amount_second_half_ratio
feature_contract.formula: amount_second_half_sum / amount_sum
feature_contract.known_risk: must handle zero or missing amount_sum

feature_contract.name: volume_spike_ratio
feature_contract.formula: max(volume) / mean(volume) over anchor-day 5m bars
feature_contract.known_risk: must handle zero mean volume and outlier bad bars

feature_contract.name: amount_spike_ratio
feature_contract.formula: max(amount) / mean(amount) over anchor-day 5m bars
feature_contract.known_risk: must handle zero mean amount and outlier bad bars

feature_contract.name: morning_return
feature_contract.formula: last close in morning segment / open_first - 1
feature_contract.known_risk: requires explicit morning segment definition

feature_contract.name: afternoon_return
feature_contract.formula: close_last / first close in afternoon segment - 1
feature_contract.known_risk: requires explicit afternoon segment definition

feature_contract.name: last_hour_return
feature_contract.formula: close_last / first close in last-hour segment - 1
feature_contract.known_risk: requires exact session clock rules for last hour

feature_contract.name: close_vs_morning_high
feature_contract.formula: close_last / max(high in morning segment) - 1
feature_contract.known_risk: requires explicit morning segment definition

feature_contract.name: close_vs_intraday_high
feature_contract.formula: close_last / high_max - 1
feature_contract.known_risk: uses full anchor-day high and is end-of-day diagnostic only

feature_contract.name: close_vs_intraday_low
feature_contract.formula: close_last / low_min - 1
feature_contract.known_risk: uses full anchor-day low and is end-of-day diagnostic only

feature_contract.name: vwap_slope_proxy
feature_contract.formula: second_half_vwap / first_half_vwap - 1
feature_contract.known_risk: must handle zero volume in either segment

feature_contract.name: price_above_vwap_bar_ratio
feature_contract.formula: count(close_bar > vwap_bar_or_running_vwap) / anchor_day_bar_count
feature_contract.known_risk: requires consistent bar VWAP or running VWAP definition

feature_contract.name: prev_1d_return
feature_contract.formula: anchor_day_close / previous_trading_day_close - 1
feature_contract.known_risk: requires daily close no later than anchor day close

feature_contract.name: prev_3d_return
feature_contract.formula: anchor_day_close / close_3_trading_days_before_anchor - 1
feature_contract.known_risk: must use trading-day calendar, not calendar-day offsets

feature_contract.name: prev_5d_return
feature_contract.formula: anchor_day_close / close_5_trading_days_before_anchor - 1
feature_contract.known_risk: must use trading-day calendar, not calendar-day offsets

feature_contract.name: prev_10d_return
feature_contract.formula: anchor_day_close / close_10_trading_days_before_anchor - 1
feature_contract.known_risk: must use trading-day calendar, not calendar-day offsets

feature_contract.name: prev_5d_volatility
feature_contract.formula: std of daily close-to-close returns from anchor day and prior 5 trading days as available before or at anchor close
feature_contract.known_risk: train-only scaling required in later supervised diagnostics if standardized

feature_contract.name: prev_10d_volatility
feature_contract.formula: std of daily close-to-close returns from anchor day and prior 10 trading days as available before or at anchor close
feature_contract.known_risk: train-only scaling required in later supervised diagnostics if standardized

feature_contract.name: prev_5d_volume_zscore
feature_contract.formula: (anchor_day_volume - mean(prior_5_trading_day_volume)) / std(prior_5_trading_day_volume)
feature_contract.known_risk: must not compute reference stats with future days; handle zero prior std

feature_contract.name: prev_close_to_5d_ma
feature_contract.formula: anchor_day_close / mean(close over anchor day and prior 4 trading days) - 1
feature_contract.known_risk: must document whether moving average includes anchor-day close

feature_contract.name: prev_close_to_10d_ma
feature_contract.formula: anchor_day_close / mean(close over anchor day and prior 9 trading days) - 1
feature_contract.known_risk: must document whether moving average includes anchor-day close

feature_contract.name: rank_day_return
feature_contract.formula: rank(day_return) within same anchor date and visible ETF universe
feature_contract.known_risk: P0 if computed with future universe membership

feature_contract.name: rank_volume_sum
feature_contract.formula: rank(volume_sum) within same anchor date and visible ETF universe
feature_contract.known_risk: P0 if computed with future universe membership

feature_contract.name: rank_amount_sum
feature_contract.formula: rank(amount_sum) within same anchor date and visible ETF universe
feature_contract.known_risk: P0 if computed with future universe membership

feature_contract.name: rank_close_to_vwap
feature_contract.formula: rank(close_to_vwap) within same anchor date and visible ETF universe
feature_contract.known_risk: P0 if computed with future universe membership

feature_contract.name: relative_return_to_universe_mean
feature_contract.formula: day_return - mean(day_return) within same anchor date and visible ETF universe
feature_contract.known_risk: universe mean must use same-date visible members only

feature_contract.name: relative_volume_to_universe_mean
feature_contract.formula: volume_sum / mean(volume_sum) within same anchor date and visible ETF universe - 1
feature_contract.known_risk: universe mean must use same-date visible members only and handle zero denominator

forbidden_features: QMT fills / account / fund / position / order / trade fields

feature_source_allowed: anchor day bars up to and including the final anchor-day bar
daily or intraday history dated on or before anchor day
same-anchor-date visible ETF universe cross-sectional statistics
p0_blockers: feature uses future daily close after anchor date
feature uses QMT fill / order / account data
feature uses Stable action / target_weight / final_buy_action
feature calculated with train+valid combined statistics where train-only is required
cross-sectional rank computed using future universe membership

future_function: Design only. Allowed features are constrained to anchor day or prior data. Labels remain after-anchor-day outcomes and are forbidden from feature columns.
stable_recommendation: Do not promote to Stable. Next step is dry-run only after review.
